draws.undefined_representation: IEEE NaN in numeric NPZ only; JSON intervals are null

cluster_bootstrap.ratio_definition: Sum of resampled component correct counts divided by sum of resampled component selected-row counts.
cluster_bootstrap.scope: Conditional on the fixed checkpoints and observed source components; not training-seed uncertainty, causal evidence, or a multiplicity-adjusted claim.
cluster_bootstrap.zero_denominator_policy: Any undefined replicate makes that metric/subset CI null; other endpoints remain defined.

competence_screen.scope: Descriptive operational prerequisite, not a causal mechanism test, significance test, or replacement for historical H1.

control_scope: Raw-text controls can answer beyond neural grid/vocabulary limits. Their original labels are never replaced by symbolic answers; all official rows remain.

costs.scope: Saved timing fields; no exclusive CPU work, peak RSS, energy or continuous RAM measurement is inferred.

final_population.grouping: Connected original episode, complete normalized fact story, or identical normalized visible input.
final_population.novelty_definition: Raw unseen AND frozen-encoded unseen; unencodable inputs remain in applicable raw-novel subsets and score wrong.
final_population.scope: Exact lexical/input novelty only; not novel entities, relations, templates or generator structure.

limits: Byte hashes do not independently establish remote archive ancestry or publication time; the operational archive audit owns that evidence.
Checkpoint files are hashed only, never deserialized; weight finiteness and parameter tensors are not rechecked here.
Recorded input streams are matched across families and counted, not regenerated from their declared PRNG seeds.
Resource and timing fields describe saved measurements and configured limits, not continuously observed physical utilization.
bAbI QA4 is external to this project but synthetic; success does not establish natural-language or out-of-generator generalization.
The source archive and original TEST have public custody; a workflow access gate is not an independent blind test.

paired_streams.scope: Identical saved planned indices and initial firing state; model-specific firing consumption can differ.
